entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: Ruthless human ninja and leader of the Hyozan Reckoners on Kamigawa, covered in magical tattoos.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: The largest and most well-known Reckoner gang on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Clan Umezawa
entities.description: The clan still in Kamigawa to which Satoru belongs.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Fabled figure Satoru claims descent from.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who was a Hyozan Reckoner given a mission by Satoru.

entities.name: Goro-Goro
entities.description: Fought alongside Satoru in defense of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Planeswalker faerie who recruits Satoru for a heist on Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Rival of Satoru, imprisoned with him.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: Helps break Kaervek and Satoru out of prison.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: Newly recruited member who helps with the jailbreak.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Benefactor of the heist, actually Jace Beleren under an illusion.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who posed as Ashiok and planeswalked away without paying.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: Lawkeeping entity on Thunder Junction that imprisons Satoru and Kaervek.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A vault on Thunder Junction targeted in the heist.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Satoru enters through an Omenpath.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion Satoru helped defend Kamigawa against.

events.summary: Satoru gives Kaito the mission to steal information about Tameshi's technology and sends henchmen to follow him.
events.quote: Suspicious of Kaito's loyalty, Satoru sent his henchmen to follow him.

events.summary: Satoru fights alongside Goro-Goro in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Satoru fought alongside Goro-Goro in defense of Kamigawa during the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Satoru is the first of his gang to Thunder Junction, where Oko recruits him for the Maag Taranau heist.
events.quote: Oko recruited him into his gang to assist in their planned heist on Maag Taranau

events.summary: Satoru and Kaervek are imprisoned by the Sterling Company.
events.quote: Later, they were both imprisoned by the Sterling Company

events.summary: Eriette and Annie Flash break Kaervek and Satoru out; Satoru stays to help secure the key.
events.quote: Kaervek escaped while Satoru stayed back to assist Oko

events.summary: Satoru is shot in the shoulder during a locomotive raid and stitched up by Geralf.
events.quote: Umezawa was shot in the shoulder, but was later stitched up by Geralf

events.summary: Ashiok is revealed to be Jace Beleren, who planeswalks away without paying the gang.
events.quote: they revealed themself to be Jace Beleren under an illusion and planeswalked away without paying the gang
